entries.blurb: Mobile-first trading + Visa-card super-app in the Hyperliquid ecosystem. Season 3 distributes 50M BASED (5% supply) by Diamond-weighted trading volume — claim opens May 11 2026.
entries.action: Verify wallet at app.based.one, claim Season 3 BASED on May 11; new users can also subscribe to Season 4 via card spend + perps trading to bank early Diamonds.
entries.effort: 15 min claim + ongoing for next season
entries.costFloor: $0 to claim, $50+ collateral if farming forward
entries.notes:
BasedApp wraps Hyperliquid perps with a consumer-grade UX and ships a Visa-rail spend card. Season 3 ran through May 4 2026 (closed) and the claim distribution unlocks today. The Diamond formula weights consistent activity above burst volume — same pattern as Backpack, so a small daily presence beats one large pre-snapshot trade.

The card / payments leg matters mechanically: card-spend accrues Diamonds even when markets are flat. If you're already in the Hyperliquid ecosystem, BasedApp is a low-friction adjacent claim — but read the docs before granting wallet permissions; this is one of several Hyperliquid-native apps and the legitimate one is at based.one (verify the domain match).

entries.blurb: Cross-chain interoperability protocol with W governance token. Post-W-2.0 tokenomics use bi-weekly unlocks instead of annual cliffs; next Core Contributors unlock on the legal-agreement schedule drops May 15 2026.
entries.action: Stake W for governance + ongoing 4% base yield at wormhole.com/stake; participate in MultiGov votes once positioned; bridge via Wormhole Connect to compound on the canonical-asset side.
entries.notes:
Wormhole's W 2.0 upgrade in Oct 2025 replaced annual cliff unlocks with bi-weekly releases (smoother supply curve, less concentrated sell pressure). The Core Contributors allocation is the exception — those tokens technically unlock bi-weekly to the Wormhole Foundation but remain time-locked under the original annual contractual schedule, with May 15 as the next contractual-release date.

For W holders, this means May 15 isn't an automatic supply event — it's a date past which Foundation-held contributor tokens become legally usable. Worth noting in the calendar but historically less price-sensitive than open cliff unlocks. Stake-for-governance + 4% yield remains the primary ongoing incentive surface.

entries.blurb: SEC-registered RWA L2 running Plume Points Season 2 — 150M PLUME allocated to wallets that earned 10K+ Points and complete Human Passport verification by the registration deadline.
entries.action: Register your Plume-Points wallet at registration.plume.org, link your X / Discord, complete Human Passport (score >20), and confirm before May 27 2026.
entries.notes:
Plume is a tokenization-focused L2 with 280K+ holders and Series A funding from Galaxy and Haun Ventures. Season 2 expands the airdrop to a wider distribution of points-earners, but eligibility is gated on registration + Human Passport — wallets that miss the May 27 cutoff are excluded regardless of points balance.

Treat this as a "claim-flag" event: the on-chain farming is mostly done; the action is the registration. The Human Passport requirement is the friction point — give yourself a few days in case score thresholds change late in the window.

entries.blurb: Decentralized perp DEX with 53.5% supply earmarked for airdrops. Stage 6 ASTER claim window closes Jun 4 2026; concurrent RWA Sprint Season 1 (zero-maker-fee gold / oil / SPY / QQQ perps) ends Jun 7.
entries.action: Claim Stage 6 allocation at asterdex.com before Jun 4; trade RWA perps through Jun 7 to bank Stage 7 points; stake claimed ASTER into single-sided pool for protocol fee share.
entries.effort: 30 min claim + ~2 hr/wk for RWA Sprint
entries.notes:
Aster sits in the Stage-6 tail of its multi-stage airdrop — by design, late stages distribute smaller per-wallet allocations but to wider eligible pools (anti-sniper). The notable detail is the RWA Sprint: Aster lists tokenized commodity / ETF perps (XAU, XAG, OIL, QQQ, SPY) and is one of very few permissionless venues for that exposure, zero maker fees for the duration of the Sprint.

Two distinct events back-to-back means you can sequence: claim Stage 6 first (no cost), then redeploy any claimed ASTER as RWA-perp collateral to compound into Stage 7 points. If you skip the claim window, the allocation does not roll forward.

entries.blurb: Sui-native CLMM-style DEX and concentrated-liquidity aggregator. ~20% of MMT supply already circulating; next ecosystem-allocation unlock cliff drops Jun 4 2026 — relevant for LPs holding MMT incentives.
entries.action: Provide liquidity in eligible MMT pools at app.mmt.finance to earn ongoing ecosystem rewards; monitor Jun 4 supply event for re-balancing decisions.
entries.notes:
Momentum is Sui's main concentrated-liquidity DEX, ranking among the top-3 venues for SUI/USDC volume. MMT itself was distributed primarily through the launch airdrop and continues to accrue via LP rewards and the ecosystem-allocation pool.

The Jun 4 unlock releases part of the ecosystem allocation — typically directed to grants, partner protocols, and incentive top-ups rather than dumped to market, but the supply impact still matters for LPs holding MMT-denominated yield. Worth pre-positioning if you're size-deploying liquidity.

entries.blurb: ZK-rollup L2 with active Starknet Provisions program (ongoing STRK distributions to early users + ecosystem participants). Monthly cliff unlock — ~64M STRK (~5%+ of circulating) drops Jun 15 2026.
entries.action: Check unclaimed Starknet Provisions at provisions.starknet.io, claim before round closes; for new accumulation, use Ekubo / mySwap / Vesu in the live STRK ecosystem-incentives program.
entries.costFloor: gas only (Starknet gas in ETH or STRK)

events.label: Monthly STRK cliff unlock (~5% of circ. supply)

entries.notes:
Starknet runs one of the longer-lived L2 airdrop programs — Provisions has cycled through multiple eligibility expansions (early dapp users → Stark Stark participants → various GitHub-contributor / ENS-holder cohorts). Worth re-checking eligibility on each round in case your wallet got re-classified.

The Jun 15 cliff is part of the standard monthly cliff schedule that runs through 2027 — predictable in cadence but each cliff has produced visible short-term selling pressure historically. If you're holding farmed STRK, plan around the cliffs rather than reacting to them.

entries.blurb: Ethereum L2 with ongoing STIP / LTIPP grant rounds distributing ARB to dApps' user-incentive programs. Monthly DAO Treasury cliff unlock (~2% of supply) drops Jun 16 2026 — relevant if you hold ARB or farm in STIP-eligible apps.
entries.action: Use STIP-funded dApps (Camelot, GMX, Pendle on Arbitrum, Trader Joe, etc.) to earn ARB incentives; track active STIP rounds at forum.arbitrum.foundation.

events.label: DAO Treasury monthly cliff unlock (~2% of supply)

entries.notes:
Arbitrum's most active retail-airdrop surface today isn't the original ARB drop (that closed in 2023) but the STIP / LTIPP program — the DAO grants ARB to dApps which then route it as user-incentives. Worth checking which apps are in the current round; rewards shift between dApps with each round.

The Jun 16 cliff is the standard monthly linear unlock running through Apr 2027 — historically ~2% of supply releases on the 16th. Predictable, well-known, but worth flagging in the calendar for farmers holding farmed ARB rewards.

entries.blurb: Real-time EVM L2. Mainnet + MEGA TGE launched Apr 30 2026. Terminal Points Season 1 is live Apr 28 – Jun 23 2026 with 2.5% of supply allocated to mainnet activity.
entries.action: Connect wallet + X at the MegaETH Terminal, bridge via Rabbithole, interact with 3 priority apps weekly.
entries.notes:
MegaETH shipped one of the highest-performance EVM rollups (sub-10ms preconfs) to mainnet at the end of April 2026 alongside the MEGA token. Terminal Points Season 1 is the immediate post-TGE incentive window — explicitly time-bounded (closes Jun 23 2026), with weekly interactions across priority apps gating the bulk of the allocation.

Time-bounded campaigns reward consistency over burst volume. If you start late in the season, focus on the highest-weight priority apps each week rather than spreading thin.

entries.blurb: Decentralized AI dataset + model marketplace. First post-TGE unlock cliff drops 1.03B SAHARA (~10% of total supply, ~30% of released) at 12:00 UTC on Jun 26 2026 — a known supply event for farmed-token holders.
entries.action: If you hold SAHARA from the launch claim — reassess your position around the unlock cliff. If you don't hold yet — Sahara's ongoing data-contributor + model-training rewards continue accruing pre-cliff at app.saharalabs.ai.
entries.notes:
Sahara AI launched its SAHARA token earlier in 2026 with a community-distribution pre-allocation. The Jun 26 cliff is the first major team / investor unlock and historically sets the tone for vesting-driven sell pressure across the following weeks.

For farmers still earning via the data-contributor pool, the cliff is informational — your accrual continues but per-token economics worsen as supply expands. Worth pre-deciding whether you treat farmed SAHARA as a long-hold or a sell-at-each-unlock position; the answer changes which sub-quests are worth your time.

entries.blurb: Ethereum L2 with active Retroactive Public Goods Funding (RetroPGF / RPGF) rounds — non-traditional airdrop where ecosystem contributors get OP for prior contributions. Monthly Core Contributors cliff unlock drops Jun 30 2026.
entries.action: Check RetroPGF eligibility each round at retropgf.optimism.io (open-source contribution, community work, dApp building); for traditional farming, use Velodrome / Aerodrome / OP-Superchain dApps.
entries.notes:
Optimism's RetroPGF rounds remain one of the most legitimate non-farming OP distribution paths — open-source maintainers, educators, and ecosystem builders have received 5–6 figure OP allocations in prior rounds. Round eligibility refreshes per round, so contribution history matters.

The Jun 30 cliff is the standard monthly unlock to Core Contributors — historically ~2.9% of circulating supply has released on the 30th. As with ARB and STRK, plan around it rather than reacting; the unlock is fully priced into forward markets but each event still produces visible spot-price impact.

entries.blurb: Sonic S airdrop final-claim window — Season 2 penalty-free starting May 24 2026, all unclaimed S burned Oct 15 2026. ~32.69M S still unclaimed across Seasons 1+2.
entries.action: Check eligibility at airdrop.soniclabs.com, claim before Oct 15 to avoid burn. Penalty applies pre-May 24 for S2; post-May 24, S2 claims are penalty-free through the burn date.

events.label: Final claim deadline — unclaimed S burned

entries.notes:
Sonic (Fantom's rebranded L1) ran two airdrop seasons and is now in the wind-down phase. The economics: claim before May 24 incurs a penalty haircut on the locked portion (S2 only); claim May 24–Oct 15 is penalty-free; miss Oct 15 and your unclaimed locked S is permanently burned.

If you forgot you farmed Sonic during the FTM-to-S transition, this is the last moment to recover the allocation. Hot wallets that interacted with sonicscan.org during 2025 are the most common eligibility path. The two dates split sharply: the penalty-free opening is what matters for most claimants — pre-May 24 claiming actively destroys value.

entries.blurb: VARA-licensed regulated exchange with confirmed TGE plan (Feb 2026) — 24% of supply earmarked for points holders, 1% for Mad Lads. Season 4 of the points program is live.
entries.action: Trade spot or low-leverage perps on backpack.exchange. Points score weekly on Fridays based on spot and perp volume.
entries.notes:
Backpack ships a self-custodial wallet, a regulated exchange (VARA license), and the Mad Lads NFT collection. The team published the TGE plan in February 2026 — 25% of the token goes to the community. Repeat SOL/USDC spot trades and 1–2× perps are the standard strategies.

Consistency beats spike volume — projects in 2026 weight allocations by activity duration.

entries.blurb: Base creator Jesse Pollak has publicly said the team is exploring a token. JPMorgan analysts estimate a potential $12–34B valuation if a token lands.
entries.action: Bridge ETH to Base, use Base App, interact with native ecosystem dApps. No formal points program — eligibility logic is speculative.
entries.notes:
Base does not have a confirmed token. The "exploring" language is consistent with what large L2s say before formal announcement. If a Base token launches, eligibility will likely lean on long-term consistent activity rather than late-stage volume.

This entry is unverified because no points page or formal allocation exists. Treat it as exposure-via-usage, not a guaranteed claim.

entries.blurb: Post-TGE ecosystem incentives. Proof-of-Liquidity validators direct BGT emissions to dApps, where farmers earn allocation rounds.
entries.action: Bridge to Berachain, provide liquidity in PoL-eligible dApps (Berps, Bex, BeraBorrow). Hold or stake the LSTs that direct BGT.
entries.notes: The original Berachain airdrop concluded at mainnet — but the Proof-of-Liquidity design means dApps continually distribute their own tokens to liquidity providers. Berachain itself becomes the venue for a portfolio of ongoing micro-airdrops.

entries.blurb: Loyalty membership ("The Club") over weETH restaking. Tiered cashback, APY on balance, and ongoing loyalty allocation toward future seasons.
entries.action: Restake ETH for weETH, hold or supply across supported L2s, optionally use the Cash card for cashback tiers.
entries.notes: Ether.fi already distributed an initial ETHFI airdrop; The Club layers consumer-grade rewards (debit card cashback, APY) on top of restaking. Loyalty tiers feed into future seasonal allocations and partner program multipliers.

entries.blurb: Perp DEX with 30% of token supply confirmed for airdrop. Points have been accruing since May 2025; TGE widely expected in Q2 2026.
entries.action: Trade perps on app.extended.exchange. Deposits double as collateral while earning yield. Equity and commodity perps (gold, silver, $SPX) also qualify.
entries.notes: Extended has been farming-grade since mid-2025. The team has stated "all value accrues to the token" — earlier participants are typically weighted higher. Q2 2026 TGE timing is community-inferred, not confirmed.

entries.blurb: CDP-style stablecoin protocol minting feUSD on HyperEVM. ~$440M TVL. Season 2 points active since Jan 2026, with Chapter 2 unified incentives teased and TGE expected by end of 2026.
entries.action: Mint feUSD against BTC / ETH / SOL / HYPE collateral at usefelix.xyz, then deposit to the feUSD stable pool or LP feUSD pairs on HyperSwap.
entries.notes:
Felix is a Liquity-fork CDP on HyperEVM that issues feUSD. The points campaign weights stable-pool deposits and LP positions on HyperSwap higher than passive collateral. The team has guided publicly toward an end-of-2026 TGE, but no token is live yet — speculative airdrop status.

CDP collateralization mechanics introduce real liquidation risk if your collateral asset (especially HYPE) drops fast. Maintain conservative LTV.

entries.blurb: Ultra-low-latency SVM L1 with $20.5M raised, built for onchain trading. Flames Season 2 is live across native dApps.
entries.action: Use eligible dApps — Valiant DEX, Pyron, Fogolend, Brasa, Ignition — for trading, lending, borrowing, and staking. Referrals stack bonus Flames.
entries.notes: Fogo is built specifically for high-frequency onchain trading. Flames Season 2 lives at flames.fogo.io/season-2. Multiple dApps in the ecosystem qualify — diversifying activity across them is the canonical strategy.

entries.blurb: Web3 loyalty platform powering hundreds of active project campaigns at any time. Completing quests yields project NFTs and token claims.
entries.action: Browse and complete relevant campaigns at app.galxe.com. Filter by chain and reward type to skip dust.
entries.notes: Galxe is the closest thing to an "airdrop ETF" by usage surface — projects routinely launch their first allocation tasks here. Treat it as a screening layer for which projects to dig deeper on, not a guaranteed yield.

entries.blurb: AI-powered DeFi automation. Season 1 ended Jan 8, 2026; Season 2 is live and points convert to airdrop allocation at TGE.
entries.action: Deposit funds, deploy no-code auto-rebalancing strategies. Earn 1 point per day per $1 deposited.
entries.notes: Glider's pitch is "set-and-forget" auto-rebalancing across chains. Season 2 points are explicitly stated to convert into airdrop allocation at TGE — formal commitment, not implication. Bridged liquidity earns points continuously.

entries.blurb: Onchain perp DEX that distributed 31% of HYPE supply in Nov 2024. Tokenomics earmark a further ~39% for future emissions — Season 2 farming is widely interpreted from those allocations.
entries.action: Trade perpetuals on app.hyperliquid.xyz with consistent weekly volume; in 2026, time-weighted activity matters more than one-time bursts.
entries.notes:
Hyperliquid runs its own perp orderbook on a high-throughput L1 the team built themselves. The first airdrop (Nov 2024) was one of the largest in crypto history. ~39% of HYPE supply is allocated to "future emissions" — Season 2 farming behavior is anchored on consistent, time-weighted activity rather than wash volume.

Always trade through the official app linked from hyperfoundation.org. Never click "claim" buttons from third-party sites.

entries.blurb: Lending/borrowing on HyperEVM with ~$347M TVL. Season 2 points program running with bonus multipliers on USDT0 supply and HYPE looping strategies. No token yet — pre-TGE.
entries.action: Connect EVM wallet to HyperEVM, supply HYPE / stHYPE / USDT / USDe to earn points, or loop with LHYPE for stacked airdrop exposure.
entries.notes:
HypurrFi rode the Hyperliquid Season 2 narrative to top-3 TVL on HyperEVM. Points multipliers favor stablecoin supply (lower risk) and HYPE looping (higher reward, real liquidation risk). The team has signaled but not formally committed to a TGE, so this is a speculative airdrop farm under the broader Hyperliquid ecosystem umbrella.

Don't loop HYPE if you don't have a margin-of-safety understanding — the multipliers exist because the strategy carries real liquidation risk.

entries.blurb: Dominant liquid-staking + Proof-of-Liquidity aggregator on Berachain. iBGT (liquid BGT) and iBERA (liquid BERA) let depositors capture PoL emissions without manually managing validator selection.
entries.action: Deposit BERA, BGT, or stables into Infrared PoL vaults at infrared.finance. iBGT compounds PoL rewards; iBERA captures validator yield while staying liquid.
entries.notes:
Infrared is the largest single sink for Berachain's PoL system — depositing BGT or BERA here turns the "which validator do I direct emissions to" decision into a single-click yield product. No token yet; speculation around an INFRA / RED airdrop is widely held but not officially confirmed.

This pairs naturally with the broader Berachain entry — Infrared captures the deeper-stack yield on top of basic chain participation.

entries.blurb: Kraken's L2 on the Superchain. INK airdrop confirmed for active Tydro and Nado users.
entries.action: Bridge ETH to Ink, claim an Ink domain name, supply assets to Tydro, trade perps on Nado, and swap tokens on Velodrome.
entries.notes: Ink leans heavily on its ties to Kraken — a top CEX backing materially derisks the protocol. Allocation rules favor early Tydro and Nado users. Unverified rating reflects that final allocation criteria haven't been published.

entries.blurb: $1B KAT incentives earmarked for ecosystem users at mainnet launch. 15% airdrop allocated to POL stakers; ongoing rewards for active onchain users.
entries.action: Use DeFi protocols on Katana mainnet. Stake KAT to receive vKAT and direct incentives, then earn fees.
entries.notes: Katana's incentives are publicly committed at $1B in KAT for ecosystem bootstrapping. POL stakers received part of an initial 15% airdrop — ongoing activity on Katana itself qualifies for continued emissions through vKAT-directed incentives.

entries.blurb: Quest aggregator with live CUBE token. Completing onchain tasks earns CUBE plus partner project allocations.
entries.action: Complete quests at app.layer3.xyz. Streaks and Layer3 levels boost rewards. Filter quests by chain and reward type.
entries.notes: Layer3 is a useful "always-on" airdrop surface because partner projects rotate through the platform constantly. Even if any single quest is small, the aggregate over months — plus CUBE accrual — is meaningful for low-effort users.

entries.blurb: Consensys-backed zkEVM L2. Linea points and ecosystem activity are linked to the broader Consensys / MetaMask MASK distribution plan.
entries.action: Bridge to Linea, swap and provide liquidity in eligible Surge dApps. Bonus weighting for foundation-approved dApps.
entries.notes: Consensys announced MetaMask MASK alongside the Linea ecosystem — activity inside Linea-native dApps converts into MASK tokens and fee discounts. This makes Linea a structurally privileged airdrop surface within the Consensys stack.

entries.blurb: Consensys CEO Joseph Lubin publicly confirmed a MASK token is coming "sooner than you would expect" (Sep 2025). Seasonal points reward onchain trading inside the wallet.
entries.action: Use MetaMask's built-in Swap, Bridge, and Trade features. Activity inside the wallet app counts toward the rewards tier.
entries.notes:
MASK is an announced-but-not-yet-launched token. Consensys is rolling out MetaMask Rewards as a seasonal points system tied to onchain activity. There is no confirmed snapshot date or formal allocation table yet — entry is rated unverified because rules can shift before TGE.

Only act inside the official MetaMask app from metamask.io. Phishing extensions and lookalike sites remain one of the highest-loss vectors for crypto users.

entries.blurb: Top-10 Solana DeFi protocol by TVL (>$900M). Distributed MET in Oct 2025; Season 2 is accruing now (points not yet viewable but allocation is on).
entries.action: Provide liquidity in DLMM or DAMM pools. Volatile pairs (memecoins) generate more fees but carry impermanent loss risk.
entries.notes:
Meteora's Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker concentrates LP positions for higher fee capture. After the first MET distribution, the team confirmed multiple future seasons. Season 2 points aren't displayed in the UI yet — accrual is happening server-side.

Pick pool risk that matches your tolerance. Stable pairs are calmer; volatile pairs earn more fees but expose you to impermanent loss.

entries.blurb: Cross-chain liquidity protocol pre-TGE. Expedition campaigns reward early depositors who bond liquidity into vaults.
entries.action: Deposit ETH or stablecoins into expedition vaults. Lock periods boost multipliers.
entries.notes: Mitosis is positioning as a unified cross-chain settlement layer. Expedition vaults are the canonical participation surface — early depositors with longer lock periods are weighted higher in expected distribution.

entries.blurb: Monad mainnet launched Nov 2025. MON token live. 30%+ of supply earmarked for the ongoing Monad Momentum ecosystem rewards program — mainnet activity continues farming forward allocations.
entries.action: Bridge to Monad mainnet, use ecosystem dApps (Kuru CLOB, aPriori LST, Curvance, Kintsu), and engage with Monad Momentum partner protocols.
entries.notes:
Monad's parallel-EVM L1 finally went live in late 2025. MON has TGE'd but the ecosystem rewards budget is enormous and being distributed in waves, weighted by sustained mainnet usage rather than one-time bridge clicks. The Monad Momentum dashboard tracks partner-protocol participation that compounds forward rewards.

Stick to dApps that are explicitly Momentum-partnered — random new deployments on Monad don't necessarily earn anything.

entries.blurb: Perpetuals platform covering crypto, equities, commodities, and FX. Points campaign is currently active and tied to traded volume and open interest.
entries.action: Trade perps on app.ostium.com. Points accrue with volume and OI. Consider risk carefully — leverage on equity/FX perps is unforgiving.
entries.notes: Ostium is part of the 2026 equity-perp narrative — gold, silver, $SPX, and FX pairs are tradeable alongside crypto. The points program runs but no formal TGE date is published, so the entry is rated unverified.

entries.blurb: Pendle's leveraged yield-rate margin trading platform. Active multiplier points campaign tied to TVL and trading volume.
entries.action: Trade yield-rate perps on boros.pendle.finance. Lock or LP for multipliers.
entries.notes: Boros lets you trade off-chain yields (funding rates, real-world rates) with leverage. As a separate product line within Pendle, it operates its own incentive accrual — even Pendle veterans should check Boros independently.

entries.blurb: Stablecoin-native L1 anchored to Bitcoin. Mainnet beta + XPL TGE went live Sep 2025. Validator staking + 5% inflation rewards activated Q1 2026; ecosystem DeFi (Pendle, Curve) plugging in.
entries.action: Use Plasma mainnet for USDT0 transfers, stake XPL once validator delegations open, or participate in ecosystem DeFi via Pendle / Curve integrations.
entries.notes:
Plasma's wedge is zero-fee stablecoin transfers settled to Bitcoin. XPL TGE'd in late September 2025 and has token unlocks scheduled for Apr 26 and Jul 28 2026. The ongoing reward path is staking inflation (~5%) plus ecosystem DeFi yield — this is no longer a pre-TGE airdrop play but it's an active points/staking ecosystem.

Watch the unlock dates if you hold XPL — Apr 26 already passed; Jul 28 is the next supply event.

entries.blurb: POLY ticker trademark filed in Feb 2026 following Polymarket's formal return to US markets. CMO publicly confirmed token + airdrop on a podcast in Oct 2025.
entries.action: Trade across multiple prediction market categories. Diverse consistent usage signals real-user behavior versus farming-bot concentration.
entries.notes:
At a ~$9B valuation Polymarket's POLY could be one of the largest single airdrops in crypto history. Trademark filings indicate the launch window is approaching. Trade across politics, sports, crypto, and finance markets — concentrated activity reads as farming behavior to the team's anti-sybil filters.

Verified rating reflects the team's public commitments and trademark filings, not certainty of allocation size.

entries.blurb: Rainbow launched a points-based rewards program with weekly ETH drops claimable in the Rewards tab. RNBW claim instructions promised closer to token launch.
entries.action: Use Rainbow as your daily wallet — swap, bridge, sign transactions. Claim weekly ETH from the in-app Rewards tab.
entries.notes: RNBW is not yet live. The points program plus weekly ETH drops is a strong signal of a forthcoming token, but distribution mechanics have not been formally published. Always download Rainbow from rainbow.me — phishing clones of mobile wallets are common.

entries.chain: Arbitrum Orbit (migrating to Ethereum L1 rollup)
entries.blurb: First-of-its-kind based rollup DEX. ~$32B daily volume across 70+ markets. RCP points reward ongoing usage rather than one-time clicks.
entries.action: Trade perpetuals on app.reya.xyz using USDC. Stake to compound rewards.
entries.notes: Reya emphasizes ongoing-activity weighting over snapshot moments — the team has telegraphed this both for sybil resistance and because the rollup-evolution timeline means later activity may matter more than early bursts.

entries.blurb: Solana LST aggregator and issuer of the INF universal LST. CLOUD governance token live since 2024. Infinity LST farms staking yield + LST-swap fees natively, no claim mechanics needed.
entries.action: Deposit SOL or any supported LST at app.sanctum.so/infinity to mint INF and hold for auto-compounding yield.
entries.notes:
Sanctum's INF is the "index" LST on Solana — it routes underlying SOL into a basket of validator LSTs and captures swap fees from the broader Sanctum LST router. CLOUD already TGE'd but the protocol still distributes real yield to INF holders without a points season.

This is the closest thing to "auto-pilot Solana staking yield" in this directory — no daily checkins, no quest grinding.

entries.blurb: Solana restaking + sSOL LST + sUSD synthetic dollar. LAYER token live. Season 2 "Emerald Rewards" active — earn LAYER through Emerald Card spending, sSOL / sUSD deposits, and Episode task completion.
entries.action: Stake SOL for sSOL or USDC for sUSD at app.solayer.org, then complete 3+ of 6 Episode eligibility criteria for tier multipliers.
entries.notes:
Solayer is Solana's largest restaking layer. LAYER TGE'd earlier in 2025 but Season 2 "Emerald Rewards" is the active distribution path now — sSOL and sUSD deposits earn LAYER while you wait. The Emerald Card brings spend-based accrual into the same point pool.

Next community unlock is May 11 2026 (today) — expect short-term price volatility around supply events.

entries.blurb: Permissionless restaking protocol with 74k+ depositors and 130+ partner networks. Points accrual for token launch with active partner-vault campaigns.
entries.action: Deposit collateral (ETH, stETH, LRTs) into Symbiotic vaults that point to your preferred network.
entries.notes: Symbiotic's vault-and-network model means each network you support runs its own incentive program in parallel — choose vaults attached to networks with credible token plans rather than just maximizing yield.

entries.blurb: AI agent platform launching tokenized agents. VIRTUAL live. Genesis Points fully active since May 2025 — veVIRTUAL governance + Daily Active Bonus stream points usable in Genesis agent launches.
entries.action: Stake VIRTUAL for veVIRTUAL or stake Recognized Agent tokens via the Virtuals staking page. Claim DAB daily and pledge points to tiered Genesis Launches.
entries.notes:
Virtuals is the de-facto launchpad for tokenized AI agents on Base (with Solana expansion). Genesis Points are the gating mechanism for new agent launches — accruing them gives you allocation in the next Genesis batch, which is where most of the recent ecosystem alpha has lived.

DAB requires daily claims to compound — set a reminder. Recognized Agent staking has higher reward density than passive veVIRTUAL.

entries.blurb: Mysten Labs' decentralized storage layer. WAL token live and paying for storage + securing the network via staking. "Boosted WAL rewards on Slush Strategies" campaign is currently running.
entries.action: Stake WAL with a validator, complete Galxe Walrus Voyager quests, or LP wWAL/WAL on Cetus for boosted APR.
entries.notes: Walrus is the dominant decentralized blob-storage protocol on Sui. The WAL token is the unit of payment for storage and the staking asset for storage nodes. Slush wallet's "Boosted WAL rewards" promo stacks on top of base staking yield. The Walrus Voyager quest line on Galxe is the lowest-cost entry point if you just want exposure.
